18de9696e0.q: What is the Soul Professional Movement and how does it blend spirituality with business credibility?
18de9696e0.a: The Soul Professional Movement is a global community uniting impact-driven professionals across six continents and more than 50 countries. It blends science and soul by helping people dovetail their spiritual self with their professional identity, creating an ecosystem where independent contractors hire each other across global borders. The movement launched a verified soul professional directory—similar to Angie's List for home improvement—to rebuild trust in business after many people lost faith in companies using words like 'authentic' and 'soul' without genuine heart-centered care.

c00b6f622e.q: Why did Camille Miller leave not-for-profit work and create the Soul Professional Movement in 2016?
c00b6f622e.a: After her role as CEO of an organic farming association was defunded in 2016, Camille realized she could be defunded at any moment and lose her job. At nearly 50 years old, she decided to bet on herself and create something that could give her longevity, leave a legacy, pay her bills in retirement, and remain true to her heart. She started with what was originally called the Natural Life Business Partnership, which is still the parent company of the Soul Professional brand today.

28fcf1604c.q: What is coherence versus alignment in business leadership according to Camille Miller?
28fcf1604c.a: Alignment means knowing your core values and business direction and feeling good about it—when you know you want to help people bring their gifts to the world and you've built a business around your lifestyle. Coherence, the new golden thread, means your nervous system and body are also in alignment. If you want to build a million-dollar company but your subconscious says you're not good enough or worthy, your body won't believe it and will sabotage you. Coherence is when your nervous system, body, and business plan move forward together.

60878df612.q: How did Camille Miller scale the Soul Professional Movement globally using Zoom in 2018?
60878df612.a: When someone in California asked her to visit in 2017 but she didn't have a sustainable model as a single mom with three kids, Camille learned about Zoom and moved the platform there in 2018. She launched 'Coffee with Camille' on Zoom to teach people that video would be the future. By 2019, she went international after learning the modality Psyche, which attracted international clients finding her on websites. When the 2020 pandemic hit, the Soul Professional Movement didn't have to pivot because it was already on a Zoom model.
